prompt:
A horizontal strip of pixel art showing the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised wall/ledge, exactly as such faces look in a top-down JRPG map (we look straight at the face; it is the drop between an upper level and the floor). It fills the whole image edge to edge: the top 6% is the lit rim/lip of the upper surface, the face below gets gradually darker toward the bottom, and the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where it meets the floor. No floor, no sky, no objects in front. SEAMLESS horizontally (left edge continues into the right edge). The strip is about 256 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels). Material: a wall of old red-brown bricks in running bond, a stone coping on top.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
revised_prompt: Generate a wide horizontal, edge-to-edge game-ready TILEABLE pixel-art texture, aspect ratio 2:1. Subject is ONLY the straight-on VERTICAL FRONT FACE of a raised brick ledge in a top-down JRPG map, never an angled or perspective view. Approximate native pixel canvas 256 x 128, enlarged with nearest-neighbor so every art pixel is an identical crisp square, approximately 7–8 display pixels wide. Exact image composition: top 6% is a narrow lit stone coping/lip along the upper edge; remaining area is old red-brown brick masonry face in running bond, gradually darker toward the bottom; bottom 8% is a continuous dark contact band at the bottom edge. Image filled by ledge from edge to edge, no background whatsoever, no visible upper walking surface, no floor, no sky, no foreground objects. Left and right edges must join seamlessly, matching continuing courses of running-bond bricks and stone coping (horizontal periodic tile). Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG HD pixel art, deliberately hand-placed crisp uniform square pixels, confident coherent pixel clusters 3–10 pixels in size, defined brick contours and mortar. 4–6 earthy shades per material, warm yellow-leaning highlights and saturated purple-red-leaning shadow colors, subtle weathered wear. Clean base color palette, neutral even soft overcast evening lighting from upper left, without cast shadows or lights. Absolutely no anti-alias, blur, soft brushes, photographic texture, random noise, checkerboard dithering, vignette, glow, or dramatic darkness.
